definitions.explanation: Money paid to an employee for their work; compensation for employment.

examples.japanese: {給与|きゅうよ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧25⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧。
examples.english: Salary is deposited on the 25th of every month.

examples.japanese: {給与|きゅうよ}⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{給与|きゅうよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My salary increased when I changed jobs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{給与|きゅうよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}している→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: The company is reviewing employee salaries.

examples.japanese: {給与|きゅうよ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれて→引く：01978_hiku⟧、⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{少|すく}なかった→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: After taxes and insurance were deducted from my salary, my take-home pay was less than I expected.

notes:
{給与|きゅうよ} is the word payroll systems, employment contracts, and tax forms use for pay. In conversation people say ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧ instead; {給与|きゅうよ} in speech sounds like you are quoting a document.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給与|きゅうよ}⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧ (pay slip)
- {給与|きゅうよ}⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧ (employment income, a tax category)
- {給与|きゅうよ}⟦{体系|たいけい}→体系：04487_taikei⟧ (pay structure)
- {給与|きゅうよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise someone's pay)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧ - the everyday word for a salary
- ⟦{賃金|ちんぎん}→賃金：04842_chingin⟧ - wages, especially hourly or daily work and labour-policy discussion
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧ - payment for a service or role, not for employment
- ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧ - a bonus, paid on top of {給与|きゅうよ}
